- `django/contrib/auth/__init__.py`: `login` (line 117) and `get_user` (lines 224 and 232)
- `django/contrib/auth/hashers.py`: the `verify` method of `PBKDF2PasswordHasher`, `BCryptSHA256PasswordHasher`, `ScryptPasswordHasher` and `MD5PasswordHasher`
- `django/contrib/auth/tokens.py`: `PasswordResetTokenGenerator.check_token`
- `django/core/signing.py`: `Signer.unsign`
- `django/middleware/csrf.py`: `_does_token_match`

A text search can't find calls that never name the function in the source, such as ones made through `getattr`, so those aren't covered.
